name: plasma_opta
notes: Opta master firmware 1.3.0: servo RS485 AUTO-BAUD. The controller now auto-detects the servo drive's baud rate at boot (the A6-RS ships at 115200; the station standard is 9600) and adopts whichever answers, so a stock drive links with no drive reconfiguration - fixes the common no-reply / DRIVE_CONFIGURATION_FAILED. Also tightens the RS485 turnaround and adds a 'servoscan' console command. Flashed over USB by the app.
